title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover ten distinct study environments at CCNY, from quiet library floors to specialized academic lounges across the Harlem campus.

cards.title: Silent Study at Cohen Library
cards.subtitle: North Academic Center (NAC)
cards.notes: Head to the 4th floor for strictly quiet study. This level is designated for silent individual work, away from the busier lower floors.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent study floor within the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: The 4th and 5th floors of Cohen Library are designated for quiet study.
cards.source_title: Can I use the library space to take online classes? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Open during Cohen Library hours, typically starting at 8:00 AM on weekdays.

cards.title: Reservable Tech Center Rooms
cards.subtitle: Cohen Library 1st Floor
cards.notes: Book these rooms via WebCheckout for group projects. They feature screens and whiteboards for collaborative sessions.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative study rooms available by reservation in the Cohen Library Tech Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Current CCNY students can reserve study rooms in the Tech Center on the first floor of Cohen Library.
cards.source_title: Does the library have reservable study rooms? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Reservation required through the CUNY WebCheckout system.

cards.title: Spitzer School Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Spitzer School of Architecture
cards.notes: Visit the Michael Sorkin Reading Room for a specialized environment focused on the built environment and design.
cards.short_summary: A specialized reading room located within the Spitzer School of Architecture.
cards.evidence_claim: The Architecture Library includes the Michael Sorkin Reading Room for student use.
cards.source_title: Architecture Library - The Bernard and Anne Spitzer School of Architecture - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Open to all CUNY students with valid ID; hours vary by semester.

cards.title: Quiet Study in Shepard Hall
cards.subtitle: Shepard Hall Room 160
cards.notes: Utilize the 10 Mac stations or quiet tables in this historic building. It is often less crowded than the main library.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, resource-rich study space located in the historic Shepard Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Music Library in Shepard Hall 160 provides study areas and Mac stations for students.
cards.source_title: Facilities | The City College of New York - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Typically opens at 11:00 AM on weekdays.

cards.title: STEM Study at Marshak
cards.subtitle: Marshak Science Building Room 29
cards.notes: Find individual study carrels and computer workstations here. It is the primary hub for science and engineering research.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated library for STEM students located in the Marshak Science Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Science/Engineering Library is located in Marshak 29 and provides study areas and carrels.
cards.source_title: Research and Study Facilities | City College Catalog - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Open weekdays, typically starting at 9:00 AM.

cards.title: Computer-Based Study in NAC
cards.subtitle: North Academic Center (NAC)
cards.notes: Use STC1, STC2, or STC3 for computer access. These labs are designated for students to connect to online classes or work.
cards.short_summary: Student Technology Centers in the NAC building equipped for digital work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tech Center includes STC1, STC2, and STC3 as available spaces for students.
cards.source_title: Study Space on Campus | The City College of New York - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Capacities are limited; bring a headset for online class participation.

cards.title: Downtown Study Hub
cards.subtitle: 25 Broadway, 7th Floor
cards.notes: If you are near the Wall Street area, use this library for research and quiet study away from the main Harlem campus.
cards.short_summary: The CCNY library branch located at the Center for Worker Education in Lower Manhattan.
cards.evidence_claim: The Center for Worker Education Library is located at 25 Broadway, 7th Floor.
cards.source_title: CCNY CWE Library | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Open for study and research; check summer and semester schedules for hours.

cards.title: Classroom Study in Shepard
cards.subtitle: Shepard Hall Rooms 51, 73, 75
cards.notes: Use these specific rooms in Shepard Hall for quiet study or attending online classes when they are not in use for instruction.
cards.short_summary: Designated rooms in Shepard Hall available for student study use.
cards.evidence_claim: Rooms 51, 73, and 75 in Shepard Hall are listed as available study spaces.
cards.source_title: Study Space on Campus | The City College of New York - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Students are asked to speak quietly and use headsets.

cards.title: Media Communication Arts Lounge
cards.subtitle: Shepard Hall 4th Floor
cards.notes: Study under the glass ceiling in this lounge. It features couches and tables, making it suitable for casual reading.
cards.short_summary: A lounge area in Shepard Hall with natural light from a glass ceiling.
cards.evidence_claim: The MCA lounge on the 4th floor of Shepard Hall features couches and tables for students.
cards.source_title: Don't Tell Anybody! 10 Secret Spots to Study on Campus
cards.access_notes: Primarily used by MCA majors but accessible during building hours.

cards.title: Isolated Study Cubbies
cards.subtitle: Cohen Library 3rd Floor
cards.notes: Choose the high-walled desks on the 3rd floor for a more isolated experience. These provide visual privacy for deep focus.
cards.short_summary: Individual study cubicles with high walls for focused work in the main library.
cards.evidence_claim: The 3rd floor of Cohen Library features study cubbies with walls for an isolated study experience.
cards.source_title: 3 Of CCNY's Best Study Spots - The Odyssey Online
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served; not a designated quiet floor, so headphones are recommended.
